name: פַּרְעֹשׁ
summary: Parosh gives his name to a family counted among the returnees. Nehemiah also records the name as Pedaiah’s father and among the heads of the people. The name has the same form as David’s word for a flea.

evidence.note: The return register counts 2,172 sons of Parosh.
Zechariah and 150 men are listed among the sons of Parosh.
Pedaiah son of Parosh takes part in repairing the wall.
Parosh heads the list of the leaders of the people.
David calls himself a dead dog and a single flea as he asks whom the king has come out to pursue.
